q.t: Fill in: She ___ to school every day.
q.e: A daily habit → simple present. He/she/it takes -s: walks.

q.t: Fill in: Look! The baby ___.
q.e: ‘Look!’ shows it is happening right now → present continuous.

q.t: Fill in: We ___ Agra last year.
q.e: ‘last year’ is a finished past time → simple past.

q.t: Fill in: I ___ you tomorrow.
q.e: ‘tomorrow’ → future: will + V1.

q.t: Fill in: Water ___ at 100 °C.
q.e: A scientific fact that is always true → simple present.

q.t: Fill in: They ___ football now.
q.e: ‘now’ → present continuous. ‘They’ is plural → are.

q.t: Fill in: I ___ my homework. Can I go out to play?
q.e: The action is complete and the result matters now (so I can play) → present perfect.

q.t: Which tense is She was cooking.?
q.e: was + V-ing → past continuous (in progress at a past time).

q.t: Which tense is He has eaten.?
q.e: has + V3 → present perfect.

q.t: Fill in: My father ___ tea every morning.
q.e: Habit → simple present; ‘my father’ = he → drinks.

q.t: Fill in: I have lived here ___ 2018.
q.e: 2018 is a point in time → since.

q.t: Fill in: She has been waiting ___ two hours.
q.e: ‘two hours’ is a length of time → for.

q.t: Fill in: I ___ when the phone rang.
q.e: A longer action in progress (sleeping) interrupted by a short one (rang) → past continuous.

q.t: Fill in: The train ___ before we reached the station.
q.e: Two past actions: the train leaving came first → past perfect ‘had left’.

q.t: Find the error: I have seen him yesterday.
q.e: ‘yesterday’ is a finished time, so the present perfect cannot be used. Use simple past.

q.t: Fill in: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
q.e: After ‘if’ (a condition about the future) use simple present. ‘will’ is already in the main part.

q.t: Fill in: By next June, I ___ the course.
q.e: ‘By’ a future point, the action will be complete → future perfect.

q.t: Fill in: She ___ the answer. (= she has this knowledge)
q.e: ‘know’ is a stative verb (a state, not an action), so it is not used in the continuous.

q.t: Fill in: Look at those dark clouds. It ___ rain.
q.e: A clear sign in front of us → ‘going to’.

q.t: Fill in: He ___ just ___ the room.
q.e: ‘just’ → present perfect: has + V3.

q.t: Fill in: They ___ in this house for ten years. (and still live here)
q.e: Started in the past, still going on, stressing how long → present perfect continuous.

q.t: Fill in: At this time tomorrow, I ___ to Shimla.
q.e: In progress at a future moment → future continuous.

q.t: Fill in: When I reached the hall, the show ___.
q.e: The show started before I reached → the earlier past action takes the past perfect.

q.t: Fill in: Wait here until I ___ back.
q.e: After ‘until’ (also when, before, after, if) use simple present for a future idea.

q.t: Find the error: She is belonging to a rich family.
q.e: ‘belong’ is a stative verb — not used in the continuous.

q.t: Fill in: Did you ___ the letter?
q.e: ‘did’ already shows the past, so the main verb goes back to V1.

q.t: Fill in: He ___ his keys, so he cannot open the door.
q.e: The past action has a result now (cannot open the door) → present perfect.

q.t: Fill in: While she ___, she cut her finger.
q.e: ‘While’ marks the background action in progress → past continuous; the short action (cut) is simple past.

q.t: Fill in: The patient ___ before the doctor arrived.
q.e: Two past actions; the earlier one takes the past perfect.

q.t: Fill in: The sun ___ in the west.
q.e: A universal fact → simple present.

q.t: Fill in: It ___ since morning, and the roads are flooded.
q.e: Started at a past point (since morning) and still going on → present perfect continuous.

q.t: Fill in: By the time the fire brigade came, the house ___ down.
q.e: The burning was complete before they came → past perfect.

q.t: Fill in: She ___ for an hour when the bus finally came.
q.e: In progress for a length of time up to a past point → past perfect continuous.

q.t: Fill in the correct pair: I ___ (read) for two hours before I ___ (feel) sleepy.
q.e: The long earlier action → past perfect continuous; the later event → simple past.

q.t: Find the error: When I will grow up, I will be a pilot.
q.e: After ‘when’ for a future idea, use simple present: When I grow up …

q.t: Find the error: He did not went to school.
q.e: ‘did’ already carries the past tense, so the main verb must be V1.

q.t: Fill in: Hardly had he reached the station when the train ___.
q.e: ‘Hardly had … when’: the first action is past perfect, the second (which happened just after) is simple past.

q.t: Fill in: By 2030, scientists ___ a cure for the disease.
q.e: ‘By’ + a future date → completed before then → future perfect.

q.t: Fill in: Rina ___ a novel these days; she ___ three chapters so far.
q.e: ‘these days’ → present continuous; ‘so far’ → present perfect.

q.t: Fill in: I ___ this film before, so I know the ending.
q.e: An experience with no time stated and a result now (I know the ending) → present perfect.
